page_title: CEL 0-1 RSO | Celta Vigo v Real Sociedad 20/01/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's it for today, Jorge Figueroa Vazquez has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+5' The corner is swung in but Celta Vigo can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
90+5' Celta Vigo take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
90+1' Real Sociedad seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
87' Carles Perez (Celta Vigo) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
84' Celta Vigo will look to benefit from a promising free kick near the touchline.
84' Mikel Merino (Real Sociedad) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
80' Arsen Zakharyan (Real Sociedad) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again.
80' Carles Perez (Celta Vigo) sends an accurate short pass. Hugo Alvarez controls the ball with a fine first touch and is able to come up with a new attacking effort.
78' Substitution. Arsen Zakharyan (Real Sociedad) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Benat Turrientes walks off.
76' Here comes a substitution. Jorgen Strand Larsen is given a rest as he is replaced by Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo).
76' Rafael Benitez has decided to make a change. Jailson Marques Siqueira (Celta Vigo) replaces Luca de la Torre.
74' A cross by Umar Sadiq (Real Sociedad) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor.
70' We can have a look at the statistics now, shots on target are 2:2.
69' The attendance is 20901.
67' Luca de la Torre (Celta Vigo) runs onto a lofted ball into the box, but hits a weak shot towards the right side of the goal that is easily dealt with by Alex Remiro.
67' Celta Vigo have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
65' Imanol Alguacil has decided to substitute Jon Ander Olasagasti and he is replaced by Mikel Merino (Real Sociedad).
64' Substitution. Jon Magunazelaia Argoitia walks off the pitch and Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) comes on as a substitute.

62' Real Sociedad slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
59' It is time for a substitution. Hugo Alvarez (Celta Vigo) is on for Oscar Mingueza.
58' Rafael Benitez has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Anastasios Douvikas (Celta Vigo) replacing Iago Aspas.
58' Substitution. Carles Perez (Celta Vigo) in, Miguel Rodriguez out.
54' The defence just can't clear the ball and a rebound eventually falls to Jon Magunazelaia Argoitia (Real Sociedad) deep inside the box, but his well-hit shot flies just wide of the left post.
52' What a strike! Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) hits the left post from the free kick.
52' Real Sociedad have an opportunity from a mid-range free kick.
50' A pass by Unai Nunez (Celta Vigo) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
46' Imanol Alguacil has made a change at the break. Aritz Elustondo has come on in place of Jon Aramburu (Real Sociedad).
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+5' The match has reached half-time.
45+2' Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
45' 5 additional min. will be played.
45' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) misses a great opportunity to convert the free kick from the edge of the penalty box after firing the ball high over the crossbar of the goal.
45' Celta Vigo are awarded a free kick near the side line and the players make their way into the box for the inevitable cross.
44' An attempted cross from Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) is cleared.
42' Miguel Rodriguez (Celta Vigo) sends a cross into the box, but Alex Remiro comes off his line to gather the ball.
39' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Aihen Munoz walks off the pitch to be replaced by Kieran Tierney (Real Sociedad).
37' The game is interrupted now, Aihen Munoz (Real Sociedad) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
36' Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
33' Manu Sanchez (Celta Vigo) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
30' What was Jon Aramburu (Real Sociedad) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
28' Celta Vigo are ruled offside.

22' Umar Sadiq (Real Sociedad) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and drills a nice strike from a promising distance towards the middle of the goal. Vicente Guaita has a clear sight of it and makes a comfortable save.
21' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Real Sociedad.
17' Real Sociedad failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
17' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Real Sociedad comes to nothing.
15' Yellow card. Miguel Rodriguez (Celta Vigo) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
14' The corner from Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) is hurriedly cleared.

12' 0 - 1 Benat Turrientes slides a pass towards Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) who unleashes a fabulous shot from long range. The ball goes behind the surprised goalkeeper and into the top left corner. The score is now 0:1.
7' Some great controlled play and passing from Real Sociedad. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
4' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it.
3' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
1' The first half has started.
